newsitem.title: UK: National Bank Hungary eyes 10-yr dlr bond - dealers.
newsitem.headline: National Bank Hungary eyes 10-yr dlr bond - dealers.

text.p: The National Bank of Hungary was expected to launch a sizeable 10-year dollar bond, bankers said on Wednesday.
"Hungary has been looking for a nice large transaction of a minimum size of $300 million and up to $500 million," a syndicate source said.
"Bids are for 10-year clean dollar global coming in very tight and aggressive," he added.
Price talk is in the low 100's over 10-year paper.
"The usual suspects are bidding for the mandate," a dealer said.
ABN AMRO, CSFB, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Goldman Sachs and Merrill Lynch were tipped to be in the running.
While some dealers said Hungary could launch $1.0 billion others said this size was too large.
"$1.0 billion is way too much paper," a dealer said.
In April, the National Bank of Hungary's deputy president Gyorgy Szapary told Reuters Hungary would launch a benchmark bond in international markets in the middle of the year.
Hungary raises its funds internationally via the National Bank of Hungary.
